value.rationale: Bayesian posterior variance is the exact mean-square error of the conditional-mean integral estimator, so the design cost matters in practical quadrature. The exact n-dependent expectation, unique optimal sampling benchmark, 50% asymptotic penalty and normalized fluctuation coefficient jointly quantify an intrinsic reliability-versus-randomness trade-off for one-per-stratum sampling, beyond a routine rate or relabeling. Precise scope and possible extensions to other Markov kernels are stated without assertion.
